source_note: FanGraphs (Feb 24 2026) overall free-agent $/WAR for the 2025-26 class ($11.23M; $12.84M for 2+ WAR tier). The 2026-27 class is not yet published, so this is the latest published figure used as the 2026 base; ASSUMPTION that 2026-27 matches it. CBA expires December 2026 so 2027+ economics are assumptions.

Realized compound annual growth of FanGraphs overall free-agent $/WAR across its annual editions (same method: projected WAR, Smith inflation-and-aging): 2020 $10.85M, 2021 $6.70M, 2022 $11.24M, 2023 $10.34M, 2024 $12.08M, 2025 $11.92M, 2026 $11.23M (table in the 2026 edition; other editions cited: https://blogs.fangraphs.com/what-are-teams-paying-per-war-in-free-agency/). CAGR 2020 to 2026 = (11.23/10.85)^(1/6)-1 = 0.58%; 2022 to 2026 is ~0%. Used for $/WAR 2027+ and backwards for backtest-era deflation. CBA expires December 2026 so 2027+ is an assumption; sensitivity at 3% and 7% in handoff.

ASSUMPTION: 2027+ minimum = 2026 minimum grown at the realized $/WAR growth rate (no 2027+ schedule exists; CBA expires December 2026 so 2027+ economics are assumptions). Note the 2022-26 CBA minimum itself rose ~2.7%/yr; also used backwards for the backtest-era approximation.
